sources: Public NCP diagnostic taxonomy reference (IDNT-era structure, codes mapped to 2023 renames)
meta.disclaimer: 完整病因（E）與徵象／症狀（S）清單以訂閱 eNCPT 之診斷參考表為準；本檔收錄 2023 公開術語與常見教學用 PES 組合，供臨床選擇輔助，非取代官方授權資料庫。

problems.label: 能量攝取不足
problems.definition: Energy intake that is less than energy expenditure, established reference standards, or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 能量攝取過多
problems.definition: Energy intake that exceeds energy expenditure, established reference standards, or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 經口攝取不足
problems.definition: Oral food/beverage intake that is less than established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 經口攝取過多
problems.definition: Oral food/beverage intake that exceeds established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 腸道營養灌注不足
problems.definition: Enteral infusion that provides fewer calories or nutrients compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 腸道營養灌注過多
problems.definition: Enteral infusion that provides more calories or nutrients compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 靜脈營養灌注不足
problems.definition: Parenteral infusion that provides fewer calories or nutrients compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 不均衡飲食型態
problems.definition: Food and beverage intake that does not support optimal health (2023; moved from Behavioral-Environmental domain).

problems.label: 液體攝取不足
problems.definition: Lower intake of fluid-containing foods or substances compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 液體攝取過多
problems.definition: Higher intake of fluid-containing foods or substances compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 酒精攝取過多
problems.definition: Alcohol intake that exceeds recommendations based on physiological needs or health status.

problems.label: 營養素需求增加
problems.definition: Requirement for specific nutrients above established reference standards due to physiological or pathological conditions.

problems.label: 蛋白質–能量攝取不足
problems.definition: Lower intake of protein and/or energy compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 脂肪攝取不足
problems.definition: Lower fat intake compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 脂肪攝取過多
problems.definition: Higher fat intake compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 蛋白質攝取不足
problems.definition: Lower intake of protein compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 蛋白質攝取過多
problems.definition: Higher protein intake compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 碳水化合物攝取不足
problems.definition: Lower carbohydrate intake compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 碳水化合物攝取過多
problems.definition: Higher carbohydrate intake compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 碳水化合物攝取不一致
problems.definition: Carbohydrate intake that varies in timing or amount in a way that interferes with nutrition-related health outcomes.

problems.label: 膳食纖維攝取不足
problems.definition: Lower fiber intake compared to established reference standards or recommendations based on physiological needs.

problems.label: 礦物質攝取過多
problems.definition: Higher mineral intake compared to established reference standards (e.g., sodium).

problems.label: 營養不良（營養不足）
problems.definition: Inadequate intake of protein and/or energy, over a period of time, sufficient to negatively impact growth/development, and/or to result in loss of fat and/or muscle stores.

problems.label: 飢餓相關營養不良
problems.definition: Inadequate intake of protein and/or energy over a period of time sufficient to result in loss of fat and/or muscle mass without apparent inflammation and in environmental and/or social circumstances.

problems.label: 慢性疾病相關營養不良
problems.labelEn: Chronic disease or condition related malnutrition
problems.definition: Inadequate intake of protein and/or energy over a period of time sufficient to result in loss of fat and/or muscle mass with mild to moderate inflammation in the context of chronic illness.

problems.label: 急性疾病或傷害相關營養不良
problems.labelEn: Acute disease or injury related malnutrition
problems.definition: Inadequate intake of protein and/or energy resulting in loss of fat and/or muscle mass with marked inflammatory response in the context of acute illness or injury.

problems.label: 非疾病相關兒科營養不良
problems.definition: Inadequate nutrient intake due to environmental or behavioral factors which may negatively affect growth, development, and/or other outcomes.

problems.label: 疾病相關兒科營養不良
problems.definition: Nutrient deficit or imbalance due to disease or injury which may negatively affect growth, development, and/or other outcomes.

problems.label: 吞嚥困難
problems.definition: Impaired or difficult movement of food and liquid within the oral cavity to the stomach.

problems.label: 咀嚼困難
problems.definition: Impaired ability to chew food (2023; replaces biting/chewing difficulty).

problems.label: 胃腸功能改變
problems.definition: Change in gastrointestinal function that interferes with or prevents desired nutritional consequences.

problems.label: 肌少症
problems.definition: Loss of skeletal muscle mass and function (2023 new diagnosis).

problems.label: 營養素利用障礙
problems.definition: Change in capacity to metabolize nutrients as a result of medications, surgery, or pathophysiology.

problems.label: 營養相關檢驗值異常
problems.definition: Laboratory values indicating altered nutrition status (specify lab).

problems.label: 食物–藥物交互作用
problems.definition: Actual or potential interaction between food and medication affecting nutrition outcomes.

etiologies.label: 葡萄柚與 statin 交互

problems.label: 體重過輕
problems.definition: Body weight below established reference standards or recommendations.

problems.label: 非刻意體重下降
problems.definition: Decrease in body weight that is not planned or desired.

problems.label: 過重／肥胖
problems.definition: Increased adiposity compared to established reference standards, ranging from overweight to obesity.

problems.label: 非刻意體重增加
problems.definition: Increase in body weight that is not planned or desired.

problems.label: 食物與營養相關知識不足
problems.labelEn: Food and nutrition related knowledge deficit
problems.definition: Incomplete or inaccurate knowledge about food, nutrition, or nutrition-related information and guidelines.

problems.label: 尚未準備好進行營養相關行為改變
problems.labelEn: Not ready for nutrition related behavior change
problems.definition: Lack of readiness to change food or nutrition-related behaviors (2023 label).

problems.label: 自我監測能力不足
problems.definition: Inability or limited ability to monitor food, nutrition, or related health parameters.

problems.label: 紊亂飲食型態
problems.definition: Eating pattern that interferes with optimal nutrition and health.

problems.label: 營養建議遵從性不足
problems.definition: Difficulty following agreed-upon nutrition recommendations.

problems.label: 食物接受度有限
problems.definition: Limited willingness or ability to accept appropriate foods (2023; moved to Behavioral-Environmental).

problems.label: 食物與營養相關技能不足
problems.labelEn: Limited food and nutrition related skill
problems.definition: Limited practical skills for food selection, preparation, or nutrition self-management (2023 new).

problems.label: 阻礙飲食／營養行為改變之信念
problems.labelEn: Belief finding that hinders food and/or nutrition behavior change
problems.definition: Beliefs that hinder adoption of recommended food or nutrition behaviors (2023).

problems.label: 阻礙飲食／營養行為改變之態度
problems.labelEn: Attitude finding that hinders food and/or nutrition behavior change
problems.definition: Attitudes that hinder adoption of recommended food or nutrition behaviors (2023).

problems.label: 身體活動不足
problems.definition: Physical activity below recommendations for health.

problems.label: 無法或不願自我照護
problems.labelEn: Inability or lack of desire to manage self-care
problems.definition: Inability or lack of desire to perform nutrition-related self-care.

problems.label: 備餐能力有限
problems.labelEn: Limited ability to prepare food for eating
problems.definition: Limited ability to prepare food for consumption (2023 label).

problems.label: 食物／營養生活品質不佳
problems.labelEn: Poor food and/or nutrition quality of life
problems.definition: Self-reported poor quality of life related to food or nutrition.

problems.label: 自行進食困難
problems.definition: Difficulty feeding oneself independently.

problems.label: 攝取不安全食物
problems.definition: Consumption of food that poses safety risk.

problems.label: 食物不安全
problems.definition: Uncertain, limited, or unstable access to adequate, safe, culturally acceptable food (2023; relabeled from limited access to food).
